correctness.rationale: For the standard-example order polytope n>=2, conditioning on the largest two lower coordinates produces V~Beta(n-1,n+2), U=V+(1-V)Z with Z~Beta(1,n), correct n(n-1) pair normalization, and independent interval-uniform remaining coordinates. Integrating beta-polynomial factors yields all multivariate monomial moments. Simultaneous permutation and level-complement symmetry reduce covariance to S,C,M,N; recomputing all four eigenmode rational functions symbolically from those entries reproduces stated lambda_0±, lambda_1± and the strictly positive difference N-M=(n²+4n+8)/(8n(n+1)²(2n+1)). At n=2 the two independent chains explain zero off-diagonal cross-chain covariances. Determinant and factorial volume asymptotics imply L²→1/12; independent local symbolic checks for n=2..7 corroborate but do not prove the general disintegration. The source checker.py is an n=2,3,4 triangulation test, not a proof for arbitrary n.
